_comment: Per-genre AAA render requirements consumed by render_quality_gate.py. 'required_3d' is the kernel-level floor every 3D game must clear (these markers are what separate the AAA Three kernel from the weak from-scratch engine). 'advisory' becomes REQUIRED in Phase 2 once the F: PBR/HDRI material library is staged into builds. Per-genre 'extra' lists additional markers a genre should show.
